projects.title: VintageOS: 32-Bit Microkernel & Shell
projects.tagline: Educational x86 kernel with preemptive scheduler & custom filesystem
projects.description: A bare-metal 32-bit protected-mode operating system written from scratch in C and x86 Assembly. Implements memory paging, interrupt service routines (IDT/PIC), preemptive round-robin task scheduler, FAT16 filesystem reader, and a vintage 2D shell with 18 built-in Unix-like commands.

projects.title: RetroCompiler: Bytecode VM & Parser
projects.tagline: Statically-typed language compiler with custom register-based VM
projects.description: An end-to-end compiler pipeline and runtime virtual machine for 'VintageLang'. Features a handwritten recursive descent lexer, LALR(1) parser with detailed syntax diagnostics, abstract syntax tree (AST) constant folding, and an optimizing bytecode interpreter running 3.2x faster than standard tree-walk evaluators.

projects.title: AlgoCraft: Interactive Graph & Tree Visualizer
projects.tagline: Step-by-step visual exploration of complex DSA algorithms
projects.description: A responsive 2D algorithm canvas designed for CSE students to visually inspect pathfinding (Dijkstra, A*, Floyd-Warshall), Red-Black Tree rotations, dynamic programming memoization tables, and stack frame execution in real time with playback controls and step-by-step state inspection.

projects.title: RaftKV: Distributed Consensus Key-Value Engine
projects.tagline: Fault-tolerant cluster storage implementing Raft consensus
projects.description: A distributed key-value storage engine implementing the Raft distributed consensus algorithm. Handles network partitions, leader election, log replication with write-ahead logging (WAL), log compaction via snapshotting, and linearizable client reads/writes across multi-node clusters.

projects.title: NeuralFromScratch: C++ Deep Learning Engine
projects.tagline: Header-only matrix engine & neural network without frameworks
projects.description: A matrix computation and autodiff tensor engine created without any external machine learning dependencies. Implements 2D convolutions, multi-head attention blocks, AdamW optimizer, and SIMD vectorization yielding 98.4% classification accuracy on benchmark datasets.

projects.title: MechTerm: Retro Vintage Terminal Emulator
projects.tagline: Aesthetic mechanical 2D terminal with CRT phosphor shader
projects.description: A lightweight web terminal emulator featuring retro phosphor beam bloom, scanline shaders, tactile mechanical click synthesis via Web Audio API, and seamless POSIX shell commands simulation for Unix enthusiasts.
